mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as accommodative policy supports valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.1pp in one month signals aggressive monetary tightening, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days via higher real rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) and weak employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1% monthly) indicate labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: Interaction signal fails to predict negative returns in >60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, declining housing starts (HOUST < 900.0) and retail sales (RSAFS < 430,000) signal weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of late-cycle expansion instances with declining HOUST/RSAFS, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 100) reflects robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through higher corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO > 100 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 800.0 thousand units signal residential sector contraction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of HOUST < 800.0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), federal funds rate increases signal aggressive policy response, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL > 5.0% periods with FEDFUNDS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of UNRATE > 7.0% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03.
